# antigravity-browser **In-IDE Web Browser & Visual Element Inspector for Google Antigravity Aux Pane**

English | 简体中文

--- `antigravity-browser` is an in-IDE web browser, visual element inspector, and console error auto-capture plugin designed for Google Antigravity's Aux Pane. It allows developers to browse external documentation and preview local development servers right inside the IDE, select DOM elements with a single click, automatically catch runtime console exceptions, and submit structured modification prompts directly to their AI agent.

## Features - **Aux Pane In-IDE Browsing**: Operates inside Antigravity's auxiliary side panel without occupying or splitting the primary editor workspace. - **Visual Element Inspector (Inspect)**: Hover over any DOM element on the page to highlight its bounding box and CSS selector. Clicking an element opens a prompt dialog that bundles the element's selector, outer HTML snippet, and rendered canvas snapshot into a structured prompt for the agent. - **JS Console Error Auto-Capture (🐞)**: Automatically intercepts unhandled runtime exceptions (`window.onerror`), unhandled promise rejections, and `console.error` logs. A warning badge in the toolbar indicates error occurrences, and the expandable Console Drawer allows developers to inspect the stack trace and click **Send to Agent 🚀** to immediately task their AI coding assistant with fixing the bug. - **Local Reactive App Support**: Built-in WebSocket target rewriting allows local reactive apps (such as R Shiny, Streamlit, Jupyter, and Vite HMR) to maintain persistent WebSocket connections through the sidecar proxy without disconnection errors. - **Dual Execution Modes**: - `🛡️ Proxy`: Routes traffic through the local Node.js proxy with injected DOM inspection, console error interception, and screenshot capabilities. - `⚡ Direct`: Loads the URL directly in a native iframe for heavy computational tasks or large file uploads without proxy overhead. - **Cross-Platform**: Compatible with macOS, Windows 10/11, and Linux. Includes Windows-specific path normalization, curl command routing, and fallback system browser openers. - **Security Hardening**: Blocks cloud provider metadata endpoints (such as `169.254.169.254`), validates conversation UUIDs against path traversal, and enforces body payload caps. ## Use Cases - **Click-to-Prompt UI Modification**: Select buttons, cards, or tables on a running local dev server, describe desired UI adjustments, and send the request with visual proof to your coding agent. - **Instant JS Error Diagnosis**: When a local script or React/Vue component crashes, send the exact error message, file location, and stack trace directly to the agent in one click without manually opening DevTools. - **Local Scientific & Data Apps**: Preview R Shiny dashboards, Streamlit apps, and Gradio tools side-by-side with your analysis scripts. - **API & Docs Reference**: Browse MDN Web Docs, GitHub repositories, and package documentation without leaving the IDE. ## Quick Start ### In Agent Workflow Copy and send this instruction directly to your Antigravity agent: ```text Please install the antigravity-browser plugin: Clone https://github.com/zhonggl951-prog/antigravity-browser.git into the local plugins directory (macOS/Linux: ~/.gemini/config/plugins/browser, Windows: $env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\browser), run `agy plugin validate` to confirm integrity, and open the sidecar panel at sidecar://browser/web_browser/ui.html. ``` ### Manual Installation Clone this repository into your Antigravity plugins directory: #### macOS / Linux ```bash git clone https://github.com/zhonggl951-prog/antigravity-browser.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/browser ``` #### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell git clone https://github.com/zhonggl951-prog/antigravity-browser.git $env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\browser ``` Validate the installation with the Antigravity CLI: ```bash agy plugin validate ~/.gemini/config/plugins/browser ``` ## Usage Open the browser sidecar by clicking or outputting its link in an Antigravity conversation: ```markdown [Web Browser](sidecar://browser/web_browser/ui.html) ``` 1. **Browse**: Enter a URL in the address bar (e.g., `https://github.com` or a local port like `http://127.0.0.1:7123`) and press Enter. 2. **Inspect**: Click the `🎯` button in the toolbar to activate inspect mode. 3. **Select**: Hover over the target UI element on the page and click it. 4. **Send to Agent**: Describe the change you want in the modal dialog, then press `Cmd/Ctrl + Enter`. The agent receives the element selector, HTML snippet, and visual snapshot. 5. **Catch & Fix Errors**: If the visited page throws a JavaScript runtime error or console error, click the `🐞` badge in the toolbar to open the Console Drawer, inspect the stack trace, and click **Send to Agent 🚀** to immediately task your agent with fixing the bug. ## Project Structure ``` antigravity-browser/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin manifest ├── sidecars/ │ └── web_browser/ │ ├── sidecar.json # Sidecar entrypoint and view specs │ ├── server.mjs # Backend proxy and snapshot storage (Node.js) │ ├── ui.html # Aux Pane frontend interface (Light theme) │ ├── inspector-runtime.js # DOM inspection, canvas capture, and WebSocket routing │ └── html2canvas.min.js # Offline canvas rendering engine ├── assets/ │ └── preview.svg # High-resolution vector preview diagram ├── .github/ │ └── workflows/ │ └── validate.yml # CI workflow for configuration and syntax checks ├── CONTRIBUTING.md # Contribution guidelines ├── LICENSE # MIT License ├── README.md # Documentation (English) └── README_zh-CN.md # Documentation (Simplified Chinese) ``` ## Requirements - **Node.js** (v18+) - **curl** (pre-installed on macOS, Linux, and Windows 10 build 1803+) - [html2canvas](https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas) (included) ## License [MIT License](LICENSE)

# antigravity-browser **Google Antigravity 辅助面板内置网页浏览器与 DOM 视觉审查插件**

English | 简体中文

--- `antigravity-browser` 是专为 Google Antigravity 辅助面板（Aux Pane）设计的内置浏览器、前端元件审查与控制台报错自动捕获插件。支持直接在 IDE 右侧浏览外部文档与本地 Web 服务，点击页面任意 DOM 元件即可生成 CSS 选择器、HTML 片段及渲染快照，实时拦截 JS 运行时异常与报错堆栈，直接将修改诉求一键派发给对话中的 AI Agent。

## 核心特性 - **辅助面板内置浏览（Aux Pane）**：运行在 Antigravity 右侧辅助面板中，浏览文档或本地页面无需切出窗口，亦不占用主代码编辑区。 - **元件点选审查与提问（Inspect）**：鼠标悬停自动高亮页面 DOM 元件。点击选定后弹出轻量输入框，将 CSS 选择器、HTML 片段与 Canvas 局部渲染快照打包成结构化提示词发送给 Agent。 - **JS 控制台报错自动捕获（🐞）**：自动拦截未捕获异常（`window.onerror`）、Promise 拒绝与 `console.error` 日志。顶部工具栏红标显示错误频次，展开控制台抽屉即可查看报错位置与完整堆栈，并提供 **Send to Agent 🚀** 按钮一键派发修 Bug。 - **本地响应式应用长连接路由**：内置 WebSocket 目标拦截重定向，支持 R Shiny、Streamlit、Jupyter、Vite HMR 等本地响应式框架在代理下正常建立长连接，杜绝频繁掉线。 - **双运行模式**： - `🛡️ Proxy` 穿透模式：通过 Node 后端代理并注入检查器脚本，支持全套 DOM 点选、控制台捕获与视觉快照功能。 - `⚡ Direct` 直连模式：原生 iframe 嵌入，适合高吞吐计算、纯看报表或大文件上传等无需审查的场景。 - **跨平台兼容**：在 macOS、Windows 10/11 与 Linux 上均可开箱即用。Windows 环境下内置 `curl.exe` 命令调用、盘符规范化与系统浏览器唤起回退。 - **安全边界防护**：默认拦截云厂商元数据端点（如 `169.254.169.254`），强校验会话 ID 格式防止路径遍历，并限制响应体积上限。 ## 适用场景 - **点选式界面修改**：在本地运行的 Web 服务中点击想要修改的按钮、表格或卡片，直接描述修改诉求，Agent 即可精准定位对应组件代码开始调整。 - **前端 Bug 秒级排查**：本地应用发生脚本崩溃或组件未渲染时，无需打开笨重的外部 DevTools，直接一键把错误堆栈打包投喂给 Agent 定位源码修复。 - **科研与数据分析工具实时预览**：在侧边栏并排运行 R Shiny 单细胞分析仪表盘、Streamlit 算法工具或 Gradio 模型界面。 - **API 与文档边查边写**：在右侧快速查阅 MDN Web Docs、GitHub 代码或包文档，省去在浏览器与 IDE 间反复切换。 ## 快速开始 ### 方式 1：在 Agent 对话中一键安装 复制以下指令直接发送给你的 Antigravity Agent： ```text 请帮我安装 antigravity-browser 插件。克隆仓库 https://github.com/zhonggl951-prog/antigravity-browser.git 至本地插件目录（macOS/Linux: ~/.gemini/config/plugins/browser，Windows: $env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\browser），执行 agy plugin validate 校验，并打开侧边栏体验链接 sidecar://browser/web_browser/ui.html。 ``` ### 方式 2：手动安装 克隆本仓库至 Antigravity 插件目录： #### macOS / Linux ```bash git clone https://github.com/zhonggl951-prog/antigravity-browser.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/browser ``` #### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell git clone https://github.com/zhonggl951-prog/antigravity-browser.git $env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\browser ``` 使用 `agy` 命令行校验插件完整性： ```bash agy plugin validate ~/.gemini/config/plugins/browser ``` ## 使用方法 在 Antigravity 对话中点击或输出以下 Sidecar 链接以打开侧边栏浏览器： ```markdown [Web Browser](sidecar://browser/web_browser/ui.html) ``` 1. **输入网址**：在顶部地址栏输入外部网址（如 `https://github.com`）或本地开发地址（如 `http://127.0.0.1:7123`），按回车打开； 2. **开启检查**：点击工具栏右侧的 `🎯` 按钮进入 Inspect 模式； 3. **点选组件**：鼠标移动到页面上想要调整的 UI 区域并点击； 4. **派发修改**：在弹出的卡片中描述你希望 Agent 进行的调整，按 `Cmd/Ctrl + Enter` 发送。Agent 即可接收该组件的选择器、HTML 源码与视觉快照进行精准修改； 5. **控制台抓虫**：当页面发生 JavaScript 报错时，工具栏会自动亮起 `🐞` 红标提示错误频次。点击展开控制台抽屉即可查看报错来源与堆栈，点击 **Send to Agent 🚀** 即可直接让 Agent 定位并修复代码 Bug。 ## 目录结构 ``` antigravity-browser/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity 插件配置清单 ├── sidecars/ │ └── web_browser/ │ ├── sidecar.json # Sidecar 启动规格与视图配置 │ ├── server.mjs # 后端代理与快照存储服务 (Node.js) │ ├── ui.html # 辅助面板纯白前端界面 │ ├── inspector-runtime.js # DOM 检查、截屏与 WebSocket 拦截运行时 │ └── html2canvas.min.js # 离线 Canvas 截屏库 ├── assets/ │ └── preview.svg # 高清矢量界面预览图 ├── .github/ │ └── workflows/ │ └── validate.yml # CI 配置与语法校验流水线 ├── CONTRIBUTING.md # 贡献准则 ├── LICENSE # MIT 开源协议 ├── README.md # 英文文档 (English) └── README_zh-CN.md # 中文文档 (Simplified Chinese) ``` ## 环境依赖 - **Node.js** (v18+) - **curl**（macOS / Linux 内置；Windows 10 1803+ 与 Windows 11 已内置） - [html2canvas](https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas) (已内置) ## 开源协议 [MIT License](LICENSE)
